in_marathi.name: Dhevan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhevan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘déva’, meaning ‘god’ or ‘deity’. In Hindu mythology, Dhevan represents the divine, the celestial, and the supreme being. The name is a tribute to the divine power and is believed to bestow the blessings of the gods upon the bearer.
